The '''RB-1 maintenance droid''' was a [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] with a small hemispherical body, which ran on wheels. Three RB-1 droids were assigned to the [[Hyperbaride/Legends|Hyperbaride]] [[DSI Hyperbaride Synthesis Plant|plant]] on [[Marca/Legends|Marca]].
